query:
WITH new AS (
               INSERT INTO platform.ip_salts (day, salt)
               VALUES ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'utc')::date, $1)
               ON CONFLICT (day) DO NOTHING
               RETURNING salt
           )
           SELECT salt AS "salt!" FROM new
           UNION ALL
           SELECT salt FROM platform.ip_salts WHERE day = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'utc')::date
           LIMIT 1
